scene: Following the buzzing drone, you skate right into Grand Transit Plaza.
picture: Side-scrolling flat view of Grand Transit Plaza. The player on roller skates stands facing forward. On the far left, a glass cloud cable pod hangs open. In the centre sits a gleaming pink bullet train at its platform. On the right, a wooden solar-sail junk sways gently at a canal slip.

a sleek pink bullet train idling with doors open in the centre
